name: A challenge in Blackrock Spire

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

summary: The Horde’s orders bring the adventurers against Warchief Rend Blackhand in Blackrock Spire. His defeat and the proof carried away from it fulfill the charge entrusted to them. The mountain holds more than one danger, and the struggle with Rend belongs to the Horde’s own contest of power. It is a separate road from Windsor’s rescue, even as both paths approach the black dragon’s shadow.
